correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exhaustive. The bundled verifier checks all 1225 unordered two-column deletions by two exact formulations: rebuilding the shortened syndrome sumset and testing whether every original representation support meets the deleted pair. The algorithms agree pointwise, reproduce full original coverage and the published single-deletion benchmark, and match the claimed histogram and nine minimizers.

value.rationale: The object is the current 50-column seed used to improve an infinite covering-code family. Shortening is mathematically central to the length function, and the source itself motivates deletion/repair searches. The exact two-column profile strengthens qualitative local optimality into a quantitative stability statement, identifies all best double shortenings, and measures how far every 48-column subset of this seed is from radius-two coverage. The claim is narrowly scoped and does not overstate this as a global length-function bound.
